How findings are classified
HIGH
  • Zero invocations over the window and no code changes in 28+ days (dead code)
  • Traffic drop ≥ 80% vs the prior half-window
  • Error rate > 20% of invocations
  • Memory utilisation below 30% of configured size
  • Runtime at EOL — no security patch coverage
  • Provisioned Concurrency with zero utilisation
MEDIUM
  • Fewer than 10 invocations over the analysis window
  • Error rate between 5–20%
  • Memory utilisation between 30–50% of configured size
  • Runtime approaching end-of-life (deprecated, not yet EOL)
  • DynamoDB table under 10% of provisioned capacity
LOW
  • Missing recommended tags (Environment, Team/Owner)
  • S3 bucket with zero objects
  • Low-traffic findings on non-production environments
Priority is downgraded one level for test/staging environments and two levels for dev, to reduce noise on non-production resources.
